entries.name: tailscale
entries.reason: WireGuard's direct-connection port: tailnet peers reach the host directly instead of through a DERP relay

entries.name: icmp
entries.edge: ICMP: path MTU discovery and ping
entries.reason: Path MTU discovery needs ICMP fragmentation-needed and ICMPv6 packet-too-big, and ping checks that the host is reachable

entries.name: ssh
entries.reason: OpenSSH and Tailscale SSH, over the tailnet only: the host keeps 22 shut on its public interface, and the edge drops it once the host is on the tailnet

entries.name: atc-daemon
entries.reason: The atc gateway's pod dials the daemon on the host's tailnet address, and inet cloud_host admits only pod addresses on cni0

entries.name: onepassword-connect-relay
entries.reason: imp-host's containers reach 1Password Connect through the host's relay, which inet cloud_host admits from docker0's subnet only

entries.name: preview-link
entries.reason: The preview service's links, which it serves on the host's tailnet address only: each redirects to a pull request's imp, itself on the tailnet only

entries.name: preview-webhook
entries.reason: cloudflared's pod dials the preview service's webhook listener on the host's tailnet address, and inet cloud_host admits only pod addresses on cni0; the service refuses every unsigned call

entries.name: grafana
entries.reason: Grafana's NodePort, which k3s binds to the tailnet range only

entries.name: nixie-ingress
entries.reason: nixie's Traefik ingress, which holds the host port on the host's tailnet address only: nixie.geoff.cloud points at that address

entries.name: k3s-api
entries.reason: k3s's API server, which the tailnet policy grants to the prod apply job and to the Pulumi runs on home-pc only

entries.name: atc-gateway
entries.reason: The atc gateway's MCP and OAuth endpoints for remote MCP clients; the gateway authenticates every call itself

entries.name: preview-webhook-route
entries.reason: GitHub's pull_request webhooks for the preview service, POST /webhook only; the service refuses every call without a valid signature

entries.name: imp
entries.reason: Held for imp's own public MCP route: the /mcp and OAuth paths only, once imp has an OAuth boundary of its own

entries.name: health-check-workers-dev
entries.reason: The health-check Worker runs on its cron only, so its workers.dev subdomain is disabled
